basis: Base FCF is official-release-derived TTM operating cash flow less purchases of property, plant and equipment: FY2025 plus H1 FY2026 less H1 FY2025. It is treated as FCFE / levered FCF as a research approximation; no net debt subtraction is applied. AVGO has material acquisition debt, interest, amortization, restructuring and integration effects, so this simplified DCF is a pressure test rather than a formal target-price model. Growth, discount-rate and terminal-growth paths are analyst test assumptions, not company guidance.
source: Broadcom FY2025 earnings release and Q2 FY2026 earnings release / Form 10-Q
